objective: Prove: (1) the transfers of a knot link either have a full product, so rings forget exponentially, or permute the blocks of a partition into two or more blocks, so rings keep a lasting record; for two-valued witnesses group-like, lasting, composing like cycles and parity coincide; (2) in a law composing like cycles, a link whose witnesses share a knot range acts modulo the tops by affine maps with one gain in the multiplicative group of a finite field, a network of copies remembers modulo the tops exactly the twisted first cohomology of its graph, and its free sets of edges are those of the frame matroid of the gain graph (graphic, one class per loop, for untwisted links); (3) the unified claim as stated holds for two values and fails beyond (S3 and Z6 3-nets, a dressed parity knot, twisted affine knots), and its corrected form.
status: Proved by LOOP-HOMOLOGY-20261021-001A-P001 (V1 prose proof with exhaustive and randomized checks; Protasov and Voynov's theorem, Jordan's theorem, Zaslavsky's frame matroids and the ring, nerve, 3-net and affine-tops proofs cited). A knot link either has a full product and its rings forget, or permutes blocks and keeps a lasting record; for two values group-like, lasting, composing like cycles and parity coincide. In a law composing like cycles, modulo the tops every three-variable knot with a common witness range has one gain in a finite field, its networks remember exactly twisted first cohomology, and their free sets form the frame matroid of the gain graph; twisted loops bind in pairs. The unified claim holds for two values and fails beyond (Z6 and S3 3-nets group-like but not composing like cycles, yet graphic on networks; dressed parity composing like cycles without permutation transfers; x + y + z over F3 forgetting odd rings); corrected form recorded.
title: Proof: loop memory and cycle-like composition
